profile.headline: Software Engineer -​> SaaS Founder
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 20 years of experience, 10 years building Ruby on Rails Web Apps. Enjoys the full stack with HTML/CSS ES6/Javascript and loves writing an elegant SQL query. Started two Internet companies–a Digital Agency that's delivered over 100+ projects, and a SaaS company.

positions.title: SaaS Co-Founder & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Onepager is the easiest way for a small business to build a website.

- Took the product from concept to MVP to SaaS business with 10,000+ users. Then developed white label platform for B2B expansion and created a REST API for partner integration. Built with Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, and MySQL on Ubuntu
- Raised $350k in VC and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, The Next Web, Mashable, Fast Company, Business Insider
- Secured partnership with domain registrar Namecheap to be their exclusive website builder
- Wore the many hats of a Co-Founder including product design, sales, marketing, customer engagement, business development.
- Developed internal tools to automate and decrease cost of running business

positions.title: Co-Founder & Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
NYC Digital Agency that focuses on quality Product Design, UI/UX Design, and Web App Development.

- Featured technologies: Python, Django, PHP, Drupal, Wordpress customizations, SEO, Shopify, Facebook Apps, AWS, GCS, ES6 Javascript
- Featured clients: WeWork, NY Tech Meetup, RRE Ventures, Gilt Groupe, Vogue, CK One, Columbia University, NPR affiliate WBGO, CNNmoney, and The Sunday Mass. 
-  Created We Are NY Tech and interviewed over 300 entrepreneurs and business leaders, mentioned on AVC (Fred Wilson)
- Helped clients design and build SaaS products using Agile software development with Ruby on Rails and JavaScript, including an E-Commerce/CRM platform combining the best of Shopify + Salesforce
- Took what we learned from client projects and started our own SaaS company, Onepager
